embeds.title: Previously reported papers (still in the 30-day window)

fields.name: Long-horizon Video Generation with Slot Memory Addressed By Region Tokens
fields.value: Google — The paper introduces SMART, a slot-based memory for long-horizon video generation that keeps constant storage size while still supporting accurate recall of content when a camera revisits a previously seen location.

fields.name: Kandinsky S2V 1.0: Audio-Driven Avatar Video Generation
fields.value: Kandinsky Lab (flag) — Kandinsky S2V 1.0 is an open family of speech-to-video models (a 2B "Lite" and a 21B "Pro" variant) that generate long-form 25 FPS video of a person speaking, driven by a reference image, a speech waveform, and a text prompt.

fields.name: Into the LidarVerse: A Real-Time Unified LiDAR World Model Across Tasks and Sensors
fields.value: NVIDIA — LidarVerse is a single conditional generative world model for simulating LiDAR sensor data, intended to combine the accuracy of per-scene reconstruction methods with the scalability of generative approaches.

fields.name: Imagining Goals with Geometric Horizon Models for Policy Generalization
fields.value: Google DeepMind; also affiliated with Mila and Université de Montréal); other authors are Mila-affiliated — The paper addresses zero-shot goal generalization in goal-conditioned reinforcement learning, where a policy must handle unseen tasks by composing existing skills.

fields.name: GAD: Geometry Attention Distillation for Consistent Video Generation
fields.value: Alibaba — GAD addresses the tendency of video diffusion models to lose stable scene geometry and object structure over time because their video attention fails to find reliable cross-frame correspondences.

fields.name: FlowCred: Hierarchical Credit Assignment and Functional Coordination for Joint Text-to-Video Post-Training
fields.value: Kuaishou; the arXiv HTML page strips superscripts, so the exact author-to-institution mapping could not be independently confirmed beyond this — FlowCred addresses two problems in jointly training a prompt-rewriting policy and a video generator on the same terminal reward: prompt-quality credit gets entangled with generation randomness, and the two modules can make redundant, overlapping improvements.

fields.name: Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Models for Consistent Future Frame Prediction
fields.value: NVIDIA — D3WM (Decoupled Drift-Diffusion World Model) predicts future video frames conditioned on action sequences by combining a deterministic transformer prediction with a diffusion model gated by a learned spatial uncertainty map.

fields.name: CityCode: Building Agent-Operable 3D Cities from Sparse Aerial Observations
fields.value: SenseTime (flag) — CityCode defines a new task of building large-scale, agent-operable 3D city models — metrically scaled, instance-level buildings plus explicit road geometry/connectivity — from a single low-altitude aerial RGB image per region with known camera parameters.

fields.name: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models
fields.value: Meta — World-T3 is a camera-controlled, autoregressive video world model that stores past observations in dedicated test-time-trained model parameters rather than a growing context window, so memory and per-step compute stay constant as rollouts lengthen.

fields.name: World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models
fields.value: Microsoft — The paper introduces the Physical Registry, a set of temporally grounded registry slots inside a video diffusion transformer that hold an explicit, readable predictive-dynamics state separate from appearance tokens.

fields.name: Unravel: Recovering an Interactive 3D Scene from a Single Image
fields.value: Adobe; Tencent LIGHTSPEED — Unravel is a training-free framework that turns a single image into an interactive 3D scene in which every object is a separate, movable asset.

fields.name: Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
fields.value: Tencent; remaining authors at The University of Hong Kong — Multics generates video of a shared multiplayer environment from each player's own viewpoint, using a three-level (player/group/global) hierarchical communication scheme in self-attention instead of full pairwise or fully-centralized communication.

fields.name: Totem: Object-Centric 3D Memory for World-Consistent Video Generation
fields.value: Huawei; remaining authors at Harbin Institute of Technology — Totem represents selected objects as persistent 3D memories anchored to a shared world coordinate frame, each with its own state, and combines these object memories with scene geometry in a dual-stream conditioning architecture to synthesize new-viewpoint video.

fields.name: ProWorld: Multi-View World Model with Proprioceptive Feedback for Closed-Loop Policy Evaluation
fields.value: Meituan; other co-authors are Sun Yat-sen University / University of Macau / MBZUAI / South China University of Technology) (flag) — ProWorld is an action-conditioned world model that jointly predicts multi-view video and robot proprioceptive state, feeding both back to a frozen policy to serve as a closed-loop test environment for robot manipulation policies.

fields.name: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
